shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A man in a red shirt sits at the doorway-side aisle seat and explains the rule of a riddle, a woman in an orange shirt sits at the shelf-side window seat, and a man in a white shirt sits at the doorway-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt enters and sits in the empty place. A man in a red shirt asks whether reversing words alters the meaning, and he answers that the meaning changes.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt asks about the broken timer, and a man in a red shirt blames improper handling for the failure.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the game table.
